about: The committed references of every view's drawing, in the light and the dark theme (editor spec §41, visual_regression_auto; test/visual-regression.test.js): each picture's file under test/visual/, its sha256, why it is as it is, and the day it was accepted. A drawing that differs from its reference fails until it is accepted with a reason; a reference changed by hand fails until its record is.
